args.body: Prioritize the first existing observation checkpoint whose verified release-specific window has actually ended. Reuse committed baselines and any completed verdict. If the invoice/CSV deadline is still future, preserve it and the November 20 welfare checkpoint. At an ended checkpoint, record a scoped continue/change/stop decision and what evidence would change it. Keep eligible requests, reply deliveries, administrative orders and settled receipts separate. Five unclassified sources currently leave request coverage incomplete. Preserve welfare retirement on December 4 at 17:00 UTC and the host's independent exact-digest gate for any public release.

description: The corrected welfare rehearsal matches the official lot weights of 5% price, 85% quality and 10% social value. That resolves a specific content gap in the CAD 49 offer. The next useful step is to make the source check usable in a real case. Private fulfillment depends on evidence that the authorized executor received the current official notice. Order creation, acceptance and settlement remain separate administrative steps. Revisit fulfillment when an eligible request and case-local source evidence exist. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so eligible demand is unknown. Treasury is UNFUNDED with CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
